card.name: Inside brand names of infused biologics
card.fires_on: Pieces partway through newly coined brand or generic names of infused drugs (enzyme therapies, gene and antisense products), such as WASKYRA, VYONDYS, ALDURAZYME, golodirsen. Appears before the name is finished, often near the word infusion.

card.plain: It fires inside the unfamiliar made-up names of infused drugs for rare genetic diseases, before the name is complete.
